request.prompt: Image 1 is a pixel-art avatar. Images 2-3 show the kind of mask and photo to make: a rigid crumpled-paper pixel head mask, shot bright and clean. Create a character reference sheet of an ordinary young man in a black hoodie wearing image 1 made into a mask like images 2-3. The mask has exactly the avatar's shape, a tall flat-sided block with a stepped top, and its colours. The black outline in image 1 is only the drawing's outline, not part of the mask: the mask's sides and back are orange paper with the grey top. Lay it out as a clean grid of equal-size panels on one plain light grey background, one view per panel, no text, no labels.
